headline: Executive order sets out how the federal government will carry out the 2021 Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act.
what_it_does: This order gives directions to federal agencies on putting the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act into action. That law funds projects such as roads, bridges, public transit, water systems, and broadband internet. No summary was provided, so the specific steps and priorities in the order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They receive direction on how to manage and spend money from the infrastructure law.
They may be affected by how federal agencies hand out and oversee infrastructure funding.
